Q5200.reason: Under Scales/Noto-style First Amendment doctrine, membership in a group can be punished only if the person is active with specific intent to further its illegal aims.

Q5207.reason: Federal courts cannot issue advisory opinions, so a case that 'has to result in' one is not a valid limitation; ripeness, mootness, and standing are all genuine limits.
